answer: A jade of per-task receipts records who did what, and the garden of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the timber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
